entries.674cdfd02e79cd72: This is the company's only segment, operating British-style pubs. The company operates 110 stores across six regions (Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki and Kyushu) as of February 28, 2026, mainly opening in downtown and office districts in front of train stations and in commercial facilities. There are two brands: the "HUB" brand, targeting relatively younger customers in their 20s and 30s, and the "82 (Eighty-Two)" brand, targeting mature customers in their 30s to 50s. The stores offer mainly beer, along with cocktails, wine and whisky, and food including fish and chips, a representative British dish. The company has introduced a "cash on delivery system" in which payment is made in advance, and service is basically self-service.
entries.848c4c0d159af448: Since its founding, the company's policy has been to offer the atmosphere of a British pub at prices as affordable as a weekly magazine, and it creates places where people can drop in easily through a prepaid payment and in-principle self-service system.
entries.983b25156f348ecd: The company is advancing its medium-term management plan (2025-2027), with 'Challenge' as its theme. The company says that, centered on its store expansion strategy 'SmasH47,' which targets people-flow locations across Japan, it is advancing store openings nationwide, and that, centered on its member system, it is working to attract new customers and encourage repeat visits by existing customers, and aims to secure and retain talent through improved working conditions. The company has also decided to open new stores around Shizuoka Station and Oita Station.
